entries.en: The distressing news left the family sitting together in silence.
entries.zh: 那条令人痛苦的消息让一家人坐在一起，默然无语。

entries.en: The distributed computing system used machines in three separate buildings.
entries.zh: 这个分布式计算系统使用了三栋不同建筑内的机器。

entries.en: The disturbed papers lay scattered across the desk after the hurried search.
entries.zh: 匆忙搜查之后，被弄乱的文件散落在桌上。

entries.en: A disturbing crack appeared in the wall above the classroom door.
entries.zh: 教室门上方的墙上出现了一道令人不安的裂缝。

entries.en: The disunited committee could not agree on a replacement chairperson.
entries.zh: 这个分裂的委员会无法就接替主席的人选达成一致。

entries.en: The documentary shows aircraft preparing to dive-bomb a bridge during the war.
entries.zh: 纪录片展示了战时飞机准备俯冲轰炸一座桥梁的画面。

entries.en: The magazine offered a diverting puzzle for the long train journey.
entries.zh: 杂志提供了一道有趣的谜题，可在漫长的火车旅途中消遣。

entries.en: A concrete barrier separates opposing traffic on the divided highway.
entries.zh: 这条分车道公路上，一道混凝土隔离栏将相向行驶的车辆分开。

entries.en: The debate exposed the dividing line between artistic freedom and public responsibility.
entries.zh: 这场辩论揭示了艺术自由与公共责任之间的界限。

entries.en: The diving competition began after the athletes finished warming up.
entries.zh: 运动员们热身结束后，跳水比赛开始了。

entries.en: The maritime museum displays a model of an open-bottomed diving bell.
entries.zh: 海事博物馆展出了一个底部开口的潜水钟模型。

entries.en: The swimmer paused at the end of the diving board.
entries.zh: 那位游泳者在跳水板末端停了下来。
